cues.en: Let's learn how embeddings work.
cues.zh: 現在來學習 Embedding，也就是嵌入向量的運作方式。

cues.en: So embeddings are what is called semantic meaning and similarity searches.
cues.zh: 嵌入向量著重於語意和相似度搜尋。

cues.en: So it's not like it's doing the old style search of if the two words are the same or fuzzy search and so on.
cues.zh: 不是傳統那種比較兩個字是否相同，或模糊字串比對的搜尋，

cues.en: It's more a semantic search where we have AI involved.
cues.zh: 而是透過 AI 進行語意搜尋。

cues.en: So in a normal search, a kitten would not be close to a cat because it has totally different length, totally different letters and
cues.zh: 在一般字串搜尋中，kitten 和 cat 並不相近，因為長度、字母都不同，

cues.en: so on.
cues.zh: 等等。

cues.en: But in a vector store where you had words like wolf, dog, cat, banana, apple, the word kitten would go close to a cat.
cues.zh: 但在向量儲存區裡，如果有 wolf、dog、cat、banana、apple，kitten 就會靠近 cat。

cues.en: And behind the scenes, such vectors have 1536 different dimensions.
cues.zh: 底層的這種向量，可以有 1,536 個不同維度。

cues.en: In our world, we of course have the three or the four if you take time.
cues.zh: 我們所處的世界是三維，如果加上時間就是四維，

cues.en: But in mathematics, you can have infinite amount of vectors and dimensions.
cues.zh: 但數學上可以有非常多的向量和維度。

cues.en: So that is how this works.
cues.zh: 基本概念就是這樣。

cues.en: This is a bit abstract, so we are going to go into some code and actually show a little on how we make these vectors, how they look like, and also how
cues.zh: 這有點抽象，所以接下來透過程式碼，看看如何建立向量、它們長什麼樣子，以及

cues.en: we check that something fits together.
cues.zh: 如何確認兩份資料是否相近。

cues.en: So in here, we have an embedding data sample.
cues.zh: 這裡是 Embedding Data 範例。

cues.en: And we're using the normal client here, but now we're not going to new up a chat client agent.
cues.zh: 仍然使用一般的用戶端，但這次不建立 ChatClientAgent。

cues.en: We don't use it at all in this scenario.
cues.zh: 這個情境完全不需要代理程式，

cues.en: Instead, we're taking what is called an embedding client.
cues.zh: 而是取得 EmbeddingClient。

cues.en: And in OpenAI's terms, one of the best they have is text embedding tree small.
cues.zh: 在 OpenAI 的模型裡，其中一個很好用的選擇是 text-embedding-3-small。

cues.en: You also have a larger one, but not all vector stores can support such big embeddings, so I tend to use this one.
cues.zh: 也有更大的模型，但不是所有向量儲存區都支援那麼大的向量，所以我通常選這個。

cues.en: So if we make one of these embedding generators, we can actually embed this sentence.
cues.zh: 建立嵌入產生器後，就能把這段文字轉成向量。

cues.en: In this case, I've just made a little Q&A part of our Wi-Fi data.
cues.zh: 這裡準備了一小段關於 Wi-Fi 的問答。

cues.en: What is the Wi-Fi password at the office?
cues.zh: 問題是「辦公室的 Wi-Fi 密碼是什麼？」。

cues.en: And the office password, it's guest 42.
cues.zh: 答案是「辦公室的密碼是 guest42」。

cues.en: And if we use this embedding generator, just say generate this text and turn it into a vector.
cues.zh: 使用嵌入產生器，呼叫 Generate，把這段文字轉成向量。

cues.en: So this actually sent up a signal to OpenAI and got back.
cues.zh: 這會真的向 OpenAI 發出請求，再取得結果。

cues.en: So embeddings are rather fast and also rather cheap, way cheaper than normal LLM tokens in terms of cost and speed.
cues.zh: 嵌入向量的產生相當快，也很便宜，成本和速度都比一般 LLM 生成文字低很多。

cues.en: So what we get back is a vector and we get how when it was created, what model did it, and then we get
cues.zh: 回傳資料包含向量、建立時間、使用的模型，還有

cues.en: the vector back.
cues.zh: 向量本身。

cues.en: And the vector is just a long series of numbers.
cues.zh: 向量就是一長串數字。

cues.en: And I will not claim to understand this fully because I'm not a mathematician, but we can technically write it out if we want
cues.zh: 我不是數學家，不敢說完全理解它，但技術上可以把它印出來，

cues.en: to and see how it looks.
cues.zh: 看看長什麼樣子。

cues.en: And it doesn't give too much meaning for us.
cues.zh: 對我們來說，這些數字不太有直接意義，

cues.en: It's just 1536 of these numbers back and forward in various different dimensions.
cues.zh: 就是 1,536 個數值，表示不同維度上的位置，

cues.en: How will it fit that dimension?
cues.zh: 也就是資料如何對應各個維度。

cues.en: This is a rather small embedding.
cues.zh: 剛才使用的來源文字比較短。

cues.en: We can also do a larger embedding here.
cues.zh: 也可以拿更長的文字產生向量。

cues.en: I have the first chapter of write and produce that I can turn into a vector.
cues.zh: 這裡有《傲慢與偏見》的第一章，可以把它轉成一個向量。

cues.en: And all vectors become these 1536 dimensions.
cues.zh: 這些向量同樣都只有 1,536 個維度。

cues.en: So it's not like this vector I create here is any bigger or any smaller than the one we just made.
cues.zh: 不是因為這次文字更多，向量就變得比較大或比較小。

cues.en: It has the same things here.
cues.zh: 它的維度數量仍然相同。

cues.en: But what happens is the smaller we make it, the less defined it will be to know what area this is in, what area
cues.zh: 但來源文字太少時，語意可能不夠明確，不容易判斷這段資料屬於什麼

cues.en: this is in.
cues.zh: 主題。

cues.en: And the bigger, the more it needs to compress the data and lose some of its meaning.
cues.zh: 來源越長，則必須壓縮更多資訊，可能失去部分語意。

cues.en: So I would say a good vector is roughly in the middle of such things like this.
cues.zh: 所以我認為，合適的來源長度大致介於這兩種極端之間。

cues.en: This might be okay in terms of size.
cues.zh: 像這樣的篇幅也許還可以，

cues.en: But the more you put into a vector, the more it will lose its value.
cues.zh: 但塞進單一向量的內容越多，代表性就可能越低。

cues.en: But you can also, if you just put in every single word into a vector, it wouldn't know what to do with that because it will just be too generic for anything.
cues.zh: 另一方面，如果每一個字各自產生向量，又會太籠統，難以理解用途。

cues.en: Vectors can technically be very long.
cues.zh: 技術上，嵌入的來源文字可以很長，

cues.en: You can put in up to 6000 words roughly because they're counted in tokens.
cues.zh: 大約能放六千個字，實際限制是以 Token 計算。

cues.en: We cannot really know exactly precisely, but that's roughly 10 to 15 pages if you wish to.
cues.zh: 所以不可能精準換算，大致是十到十五頁文字。

cues.en: But figuring out how big a vector should be, should it be one sentence at a time, should it be one paragraph at a time, should it be one chapter at a
cues.zh: 至於應該每句話、每個段落、每個章節，

cues.en: time, a page, and so on, is a whole science that we can talk, we could make a course just about that by itself.
cues.zh: 或每一頁建立一個向量，是一整門學問，光這個主題就能做成一門課。

cues.en: And I'm no expert, but I'm slowly learning as we go along.
cues.zh: 我也不是這方面的專家，仍然在逐步學習。

cues.en: What we can do is, of course, we can go in and show that same vector and we'll just see a whole lot of
cues.zh: 當然，也可以把這個向量印出來，又會看到很多

cues.en: numbers again with different values in terms of the different dimensions.
cues.zh: 數字，只是各個維度的數值不同。

cues.en: But again, it's not like just because it was a longer text that it's a longer vector.
cues.zh: 再次提醒，不是來源文字較長，向量就會較長，

cues.en: They will be exactly the same length.
cues.zh: 它們的長度完全相同。

cues.en: So now we have some vectors and I've just asked ChatGBT to make me a co
cues.zh: 現在已經有幾個向量。我請 ChatGPT 幫我寫了一個餘弦

cues.en: -similarity search score that can compare two vectors to each other and see how close they are together.
cues.zh: 相似度計算，能比較兩個向量彼此有多接近。

cues.en: Because that's how things work.
cues.zh: 因為向量搜尋就是這樣運作。

cues.en: So I won't claim that I understand this code specifically, but it's going in and figuring out how close are two vectors to each
cues.zh: 我不敢說自己完全理解這段數學程式，但它會計算兩個向量彼此

cues.en: other and giving a value between zero, meaning it had absolutely nothing to do with each other, and one being it was the exact
cues.zh: 有多接近，回傳零到一之間的數值。零代表完全不相關，一代表

cues.en: same sentence that was vectorised.
cues.zh: 向量化的內容完全相同。

cues.en: So if we go in and ask, how close are our Wi-Fi data with the book data?
cues.zh: 先問：Wi-Fi 資料和書本資料有多相近？

cues.en: And hopefully you will intuitively know that in private purchase, they probably don't talk a lot about Wi-Fi and offices and so on.
cues.zh: 直覺上，你應該知道《傲慢與偏見》不太會談到 Wi-Fi 或辦公室，

cues.en: So they're probably not too similar.
cues.zh: 所以它們應該不相似。

cues.en: And what we see is that that's correct.
cues.zh: 結果也確實如此，

cues.en: It's like 0.10 out of 1.
cues.zh: 分數大約是 0.10，滿分為 1，

cues.en: So a fairly low score.
cues.zh: 所以相當低。

cues.en: But if we want to check a bit more realistic, we can make a small vector here that says, how can my customer use
cues.zh: 如果想測試更真實的情境，可以把這個問題轉成向量：「我的客戶要怎麼使用

cues.en: the Wi-Fi?
cues.zh: Wi-Fi？」

cues.en: This is what a real person would perhaps ask for.
cues.zh: 這可能是真正使用者會問的方式。

cues.en: They wouldn't know to ask, what is the Wi-Fi for the office and so on.
cues.zh: 他不一定會精準問「辦公室的 Wi-Fi 密碼是什麼？」。

cues.en: They would just, I have a customer at the office at the moment.
cues.zh: 可能只是現在辦公室來了客戶，

cues.en: They need to get onto the Wi-Fi.
cues.zh: 客戶需要連線 Wi-Fi。

cues.en: They don't specify the word guest.
cues.zh: 問題沒有特別寫訪客，

cues.en: They don't specify office and anything.
cues.zh: 也沒特別寫辦公室等等。

cues.en: So we can make a vector of that and check the similarity search between our Wi -Fi data and the question.
cues.zh: 把問題轉成向量，再和 Wi-Fi 資料比較相似度。

cues.en: And here we get a better score, 0 .45, which is a rather okay score, but of course it's not a one.
cues.zh: 這次分數更高，是 0.45，還算不錯，但當然不是 1。

cues.en: But again, a one would never really happen, because if that were to happen, the end user would have written exactly this sentence with
cues.zh: 實際上幾乎不會剛好是 1，因為那代表使用者寫了完全相同的句子，連

cues.en: colons in exactly the same places and so on.
cues.zh: 冒號的位置都一模一樣。

cues.en: So a 45 is a pretty okay, and if we only had these two, this would of course be the best match.
cues.zh: 所以 0.45 還算可以。如果只有這兩份資料，這個當然就是最佳匹配。

cues.en: We can ask in a different way, what is the office Wi-Fi?
cues.zh: 也可以換個問法：「辦公室的 Wi-Fi 是什麼？」。

cues.en: And if we do that, we get an even better score, because there's more similarity of this sentence compared to our original Q&A
cues.zh: 這次會得到更高的分數，因為和原本問答中的

cues.en: in terms of this question.
cues.zh: 問題更相近。

cues.en: But again, if the book is totally different, so we had these three, then this one would be the best way of curing to
cues.zh: 但書本資料完全不同，所以在這些選項裡，這個查詢會更容易

cues.en: get our right information.
cues.zh: 取得正確資訊。

cues.en: So it's all about these numbers, and in reality, we are not sitting and doing the match score ourselves.
cues.zh: 所以關鍵就是這些數值。實務上，不需要自己撰寫相似度計算，

cues.en: That's the job of a vector store, and we are just doing here a sample.
cues.zh: 那是向量儲存區的工作，這裡只是為了示範。

cues.en: I've never in real life written code like this, but in order for us to quickly see that we have different scores for different
cues.zh: 我實際開發時從沒寫過這種程式，不過為了快速展示不同向量之間，

cues.en: vectors when they're compared, it's nice to know.
cues.zh: 比較後會得到不同分數，知道這件事很有幫助。

cues.en: But again, when we go to the vector store in the next lecture, we will let that do this similarity score.
cues.zh: 下一堂進入向量儲存區後，就交由它計算相似度。

cues.en: In this case, we're using cosine similarity, where it's between 0 and 1.
cues.zh: 這個範例採用餘弦相似度，這裡的結果落在零到一之間。

cues.en: Others use from minus 1 to 1.
cues.zh: 有些方案使用負一到一，

cues.en: Some use from 0 to 2.
cues.zh: 有些則是零到二，

cues.en: So there's different ways.
cues.zh: 所以有不同做法。

cues.en: So you need to check on your vector store what is a good score, because sometimes a negative score is a good score.
cues.zh: 你必須確認自己的向量儲存區，什麼分數才算好，因為某些計分方式中，負值也可能是好結果。

cues.en: That's all depending on the implementation of how the mathematician have said, this is the best way for me to check two vectors together.
cues.zh: 這完全取決於底層數學實作，如何定義兩個向量的接近程度。

cues.en: But now we should be ready to go to our vector store part.
cues.zh: 現在可以準備進入向量儲存區的部分了。
